race.comment: ROLL THE ACES (1) could be close to another win after placing in two of his last three attempts at this circuit and distance, working but sticking on well for third last time. Led from a wider barrier when he scored here in August so has the speed to take advantage of the ace draw. THE DEMOCRAT (2) has been freshened since he was down the track last time and was going well with a series of top-two results prior including a win at Ballarat. Should enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position so could measure up. TUFFASOLDBOOTS (10) is working towards a win having come from this barrier for a respectable second at his most recent appearance at this circuit and distance. DIDNT I (7) draws wide but has been solid from the back row of late.
